title: Looped Actor: Depth-Recurrent Reasoning Models for Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.37432v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Looped reasoning models repeatedly apply a shared set of parameters, enabling more computation without increasing the model size. These models also support input-dependent computation by dynamically deciding when to stop looping. Motivated by the recent success of looped transformers in language modeling and reasoning, we investigate whether dynamic looping can similarly benefit sequential decision-making. We provide a complexity-theoretic motivation for this approach by showing that there exist Markov decision processes in which a state-adaptive policy achieves the optimal return with asymptotically less expected computation than any optimal fixed-runtime policy. To learn compute-adaptive policies in practice, we introduce Looped Actor, a transformer-based policy that repeatedly refines a latent representation toward a fixed point using a shared computational block. translated_title: 循环执行者：面向强化学习的深度递归推理模型
translated_abstract: 循环推理模型通过重复应用一组共享参数，在不增加模型规模的情况下获得更多计算能力。这些模型还通过动态决定何时停止循环来支持依赖于输入的计算。受循环Transformer在语言建模与推理领域近期成功的启发，我们研究了动态循环是否能同样使序列决策任务受益。我们为这一方法提供了复杂性理论层面的动机：我们证明存在这样一类马尔可夫决策过程，其中状态自适应策略能够以渐进意义上更少的期望计算量达到最优回报，而任何固定运行时长的最优策略都无法做到这一点。为了在实践中学习计算自适应的策略，我们提出了Looped Actor，这是一种基于Transformer的策略，它利用共享的计算模块，通过反复精炼潜在表示使其逐步逼近不动点。这使得模型能够通过改变……（摘要在此处截断）来自适应地分配计算量。
tldr: 该论文提出Looped Actor——一种利用共享计算块反复将潜在表示精炼至不动点的深度循环强化学习策略，并从复杂性理论证明状态自适应计算能以渐进更少的计算量达到最优回报，从而实现计算量自适应分配的序列决策。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Looped Actor, a depth-recurrent reinforcement learning policy that repeatedly refines a latent representation toward a fixed point using a shared computational block, and provides complexity-theoretic evidence that state-adaptive computation can achieve optimal returns with asymptotically less computation, enabling compute-adaptive sequential decision-making.
